architecture.pipeline: IMMUTABLE STRATEGY BYTES + STARTING-LEDGER BYTES + WindowPlanIdentity + frozen draw -> windowSpecFromAcquisitionWindowStrategy -> PrecommittedWindowSpec -> buildPrecommittedWindowPlan -> computePrecommittedWindowPreflight
architecture.historicalAdapter: windowSpecFromNextWindowStrategy kept byte-for-byte; it remains the only path for the post-Window-V1 strategy shape (candidateWindowV2), and the generic adapter refuses that shape
architecture.strategyFileFacts: the adapter re-hashes the supplied strategy text; path must be docs/evaluation/<records>.json; the parsed record IS the hashed bytes
architecture.planIdentity: caller-side WindowPlanIdentity (recordId, records, windowName); refused if malformed or equal to the strategy's own identity; never read from a plan and never selects a work item
architecture.governanceBinding: { strategy } only: the strategy bytes bind every other artifact it names by SHA, so re-hashing the strategy transitively re-proves them
architecture.genericValidatorReused: precommittedWindowSpecViolations runs on the adapter's output; any violation refuses; splits, digests, duplicates, canonical ids and monotonic reserve positions are not re-implemented

specIndependence.proof: the adapter takes one argument whose keys are exactly the five above; a plan mutated and resealed after spec creation fails P7 (windowPlanValid, workItemsMatchFrozenPlan)

mechanism: sha256 and byte length of the supplied ledger TEXT must equal strategy.bound.replacementLedger sha256/bytes
the parsed ledger must validate against the frozen draw (validateReplacementLedger)
its ledgerHash and entry count must equal the bound ledgerHash/entries, and it must extend the genesis header
generation state replacementLedgerEntries, reserveConsumed and nextUnusedReservePosition must equal the entry count and reserveUnused = 40 - entries

occupantKindDerivation.mechanism: currentOccupantForSelectionIndex(draw, validatedLedger, slot).occupantKind: ORIGINAL_SELECTION if no ledger entry has the slot, else RESERVE_REPLACEMENT (the latest entry for that slot); the strategy's claimed replacesOccupant must equal it, and the spec carries the DERIVED value
occupantKindDerivation.syntheticChainResult: slot 3 replaced by reserve 0 then reserve 4 -> R:3:5 derives RESERVE_REPLACEMENT; a claim of ORIGINAL_SELECTION is refused; P7 refuses before the append and is all-green after the append whose replacedOccupantKind is RESERVE_REPLACEMENT with previousSequenceForSlot 4; appending slot 10 instead is refused

mechanism: each obligation: selectionIndex 0..109, reason in the frozen vocabulary, not duplicated, a CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE, not under PENDING_CAPABILITY_REVIEW
each REPLACEMENT item: an obligation exists for its slot and its replacementReason equals the obligation's reason
replacement slots/positions in window order equal planPendingReplacementObligations(draw, ledger, slots) (ascending slot, next unused positions, no gap/repeat/reorder, no reserve identity consulted)

primaryValidation: no reserve position, reason or occupant; SELECTION digest; slots are nextNeverStartedSelectionIndex + k in order; slot still ORIGINAL_SELECTION; split and digest re-proven by the generic validator
p6: stated result must equal the derived (entries > 10 AND successful < 50); a firing P6 refuses planning
